quality_notes: limited certainty of advantage over other strategies
limits_harms: more well-designed long-term studies needed; LDL increases common in literature

participants_criteria: adults with obesity; both arms calorie-restricted (1500-1800 kcal men / 1200-1500 women)

limits_harms: no difference in weight or metabolic factors; no substantial AE difference

app_safe_statement: Time-restricted eating with calorie restriction produced similar weight loss to daily calorie restriction alone over 12 months in this trial.
